variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original finished Chinese title logo for the historical interactive narrative game "逆转五丈原". EXACT five simplified Chinese characters, 逆 转 五 丈 原, correct and unmistakably readable, no extra words of any kind. The game concerns reversing tragic Three Kingdoms history through dialogue, evidence, decisions and rescue; mature, human, dramatic. This is a fresh art-direction concept, not merely a color variant of an existing wordmark. Bespoke hand-designed Chinese lettering, no named font and no copying another game's logo, emblem, character shapes or distinctive composition. Refined calligraphic authorship with strong readable negative space. Core palette: yellow/aged gold, vermilion/deep red, carbon black. Design must work on a public exhibition and in a cinematic game title screen. Produce isolated usable logo with genuinely transparent background, generous margins and every stroke inside frame. NO scene, poster, background rectangle, product mockup, comparison grid, labels, English, slogan, watermark, extra seal text, dragons, swords, wings, heraldic ornament or particles. Material remains within glyphs and deliberate minimal integrated strokes. No enormous uniform black outline, cheap chrome, inflated bevel, excessive golden glitter. Preserve character anatomy despite expressive design. ART DIRECTION 01: expressive black ink and irregular gold leaf, broad CINEMATIC HORIZONTAL lockup approximately 3:1. Freely written semi-running script 逆转 in deep black with a few bold gold dry-brush ridges and dark cinnabar at the ending strokes. 五丈原 in warm mellow gold, visibly brushed with carbon-black breaks and a little vermilion pigment at the lower tips. Make 逆转 distinctly airy and fluid; lean main strokes with long razor-tapered returns, inventive open counters, confident abrupt changes in brush pressure. 五丈原 compact, weighty and relatively upright, not the same motion on every letter. Design a memorable reverse-turning lower stroke belonging to 逆, NOT a detached commercial swoosh. Almost flat ink-and-foil texture with shallow tactile grain, only enough depth to catch a few soft highlights. A serious mature narrative-game wordmark with bold angular character, elegant individual stroke shapes rather than uniform stock brush fonts.
